Security and stability update.

- Every library Reach is built on is now on its latest version, closing all
  the known security issues in them, including 12 in the SSH library.
- Remote desktop runs on the newest IronRDP.
- Your vault, saved logins and known servers carry over untouched.
- The Turso token from first-run setup is no longer kept on disk unencrypted.
- Every change is now tested on Windows, macOS, Linux and Android before release.

Full details: https://github.com/alexandrosnt/Reach/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
